description: This Java source file defines an exception mapper class 'JakartaValidationExceptionMapper' that handles 'ConstraintViolationException's, converting them into HTTP 400 Bad Request responses with a detailed error response. It integrates Jakarta Validation, JAX-RS, and Spring annotations and dependencies.

classes.name: JakartaValidationExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class implementing a JAX-RS exception mapper for handling jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolationException, logging the error and generating a structured API error response.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a ConstraintViolationException into an HTTP Response with a standardized error payload.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns an integer error code representing validation errors.

methods.name: getApiParameterErrors
methods.description: Extracts and converts constraint violations from the exception into a list of ApiParameterError objects.
